# #1903: Patch: the networked e2e specs take their api, bearer and session helpers from support
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Fifteen Cypress specs that talk to the server each carry a private copy of the same two tiny helpers — one that builds an API URL, one that builds an auth header — several re-declare the session-storage key that support already exports, and a few hand-roll a visit-with-session helper that the shared `cy.visitAs` already provides. After this they all import the one shared implementation: no behaviour change, roughly 115 fewer lines, and one place to fix if the session shape ever moves.

## Why

Identical `function api(path: string)` + `function bearer(account)` pair in 15 spec files (`05-reconnect` through `45-economy-loop`); `SESSION_STORAGE_KEY` re-declared in 4-6 specs though `e2e/support/config.ts:56` exports it; a hand-rolled `visitAs` in 4 specs duplicates `commands.ts:842-885` (`cy.visitAs`/`cy.signIn`/`carrySession`, which already preserves session-write ordering before a caller's `onBeforeLoad`). Mirrors the accepted web-test dedup (#1814).

## Proposal

Export `apiUrl`/`bearerHeaders` from `e2e/support/config.ts`, use `cy.visitAs` (with an `onBeforeLoad` passthrough for `39-replays`' download spy) everywhere, and import `SESSION_STORAGE_KEY`.

## Where it lands

`e2e/cypress/e2e/*.cy.ts` (~19 files), `e2e/support/config.ts:46-56`, `e2e/support/commands.ts:815-885`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No spec declares its own `api`, `bearer`, `visitAs` or `SESSION_STORAGE_KEY`.
- [ ] Touched specs behave identically — the same URL string, header record and session JSON shape.
- [ ] `pnpm exec cypress run` on the touched specs against the `E2E=1` server (daily suite covers all).

## Size and risks

Medium, difficulty medium: ~19 files, ~115 net lines deleted; e2e-only, no production code. Risk: keeping each spec's exact mount/write ordering — mechanical, caught by running the specs.
